notes: Behemoth overlay: a severed tail (or any part the game refills the instant it breaks) now shows BROKEN. The game's break event names only the behemoth, so the overlay now finds the broken part right after it: the one whose health is at 0, is removed, or jumps back up (part health never rises otherwise). Once found, it stays BROKEN until a new behemoth. After updating, close the game fully and start it again.
